name: Service-Level Indicators
description: Define SLIs for each service: availability, latency, error rate, throughput, durability. Measure and publish.
acceptanceCriteria: SLIs defined for every production service
Availability SLI measured as uptime percentage
Latency SLI measured as request duration
Error rate SLI measured as failure ratio
Throughput SLI measured as request counts
SLIs published to a metrics endpoint
